description: Apply a range edit to a file within a simulation session. Changes are held in-memory only. The session captures baseline diagnostics on first edit to each file, then tracks versions for subsequent edits. Returns the new version number after the edit. All line/column positions are 1-indexed (matching editor line numbers).

end_column.description: 1-indexed end column of the range to replace

end_line.description: 1-indexed end line of the range to replace

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to edit within the session

new_text.description: Replacement text for the specified range

start_column.description: 1-indexed start column of the range to replace

start_line.description: 1-indexed start line of the range to replace

name: simulate_edit
